# page routes link to the component they render (JSX routes, nested paths joined)
PAGE /users -> UsersList
PAGE /users/:id -> UserPage
PAGE /settings -> Settings
# route-config objects (children joined to the parent path)
PAGE /admin -> Settings
PAGE /admin/audit -> Settings
# Next.js file routes: the default export; route groups don't appear in the URL
PAGE /users/[id] -> UserProfilePage
PAGE /about -> AboutPage
# navigation sites link to the page routes their path matches
Header -> PAGE /settings
useOpenUser -> PAGE /users/:id
useOpenUser -> PAGE /users/[id]
toAudit -> PAGE /admin/audit
!goHome -> PAGE /users
